mechanism: Bitcoin market value relative to realized value may proxy unrealized profit/cost-basis pressure. Extreme valuation states may contain information about subsequent medium-horizon returns and differ economically from leverage/funding, options, trend, or protocol-fee demand.

literature_anchor.title: From Network Fundamentals to Macro-Financial Integration: The Evolving Predictability of Bitcoin Returns
literature_anchor.public_claim: The paper reports that market-to-realized value (MVRV), funding rates, and open interest predict Bitcoin returns across identified regimes.
literature_anchor.boundary: Literature motivates source validation only; no outcome conclusion is imported.

target_semantics: realized capitalization in USD and current market capitalization in USD, OR
a directly published MVRV metric with clear metadata

frozen_checks: Discover exact BTC metric IDs whose metadata explicitly reference realized capitalization or MVRV.
Require at least 95% coverage over 2019-2025 for either direct MVRV or both market cap + realized cap.
Require positive finite values and no duplicate daily timestamps.
Do not calculate any future return, regression, threshold, PnL or 2026 outcome.
full_rule: A semantically valid direct MVRV series OR market-cap/realized-cap pair exists with >=95% daily coverage 2019-2025 and no authentication.
limited_rule: Semantically valid series exists with >=80% daily coverage over at least four calendar years.

anti_duplication.repo_search_at_freeze: No branch matching mvrv, realized-cap, realized-profit, realized-loss or sopr.
anti_duplication.material_difference: Cost-basis valuation state, not leverage, miner flow, or network fee demand.
